sentences.en: The owner of the stall, a large, thuggish man, grabbed Dai by the collar.

sentences.en: There was nothing thuggish about him but he looked like a gymnast.

sentences.en: I wish Obama and his thuggish advisors understood that.

sentences.en: Thuggish bush mentality It seems a dreadful irony.

sentences.en: Thuggish or not...we're living better now than at any other time.

sentences.en: Do these thuggish types deserve the mythical status that the movie seeks to confer?
